mapping_semantics: DEC-ID crosswalk means analogous project decision, not equivalence or implementation completion. Project-specific nodes are labeled. Source rules are not product policy.
execution_boundary: Most design choices are prompt-guided Agent/LLM judgments. The source does not define a deterministic scorer or model runtime. Quick smoke artifacts show output, not hidden reasoning. Default is source-only.

decision_nodes.name: Generate profile route
decision_nodes.input: Task and source type; quick intent; fidelity requirements; existing deck invariants.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Apply the routing matrix and profile hard boundaries; page count alone never selects Quick.
decision_nodes.output: Selected workflow authority and mutation/output contract.
decision_nodes.fallback: Route away from Generate when deck preservation/editing rules require it; do not silently substitute routes.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Quick observed; Default not executed.

decision_nodes.name: Source roles, provenance, and sufficiency
decision_nodes.input: User files/text/URLs and requested outcome.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Read or convert supported formats, preserve source identities, research only identified factual gaps, and keep claims sourced.
decision_nodes.output: Imported source bundle, conversions/sidecars and bounded research pair when needed.
decision_nodes.fallback: Skipped or failed conversions remain absent and are reported; free reshaping never licenses invented facts.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Quick smoke imported Markdown and facts; no conversion was needed.

decision_nodes.name: Canvas format and aspect ratio
decision_nodes.input: User/source canvas fact, project init, and selected template canvas.
decision_nodes.candidates: Registered formats; Quick uses a Layout/Deck owner's canvas or the documented ppt169 default.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Use exact registered evidence; otherwise Default confirms Stage 1. All page SVGs share the first viewBox.
decision_nodes.output: One canvas format and viewBox for the roster.
decision_nodes.fallback: Do not infer from environment; invalid format is rejected; unresolved Default canvas waits for confirmation.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: P01-01 output has one widescreen canvas; rationale is not persisted.

decision_nodes.name: Communication contract and audience
decision_nodes.input: Request, source facts, audience outcome, delivery context and afterlife.
decision_nodes.candidates: Open prose: audience, intent, outcome, core message, delivery context and artifact afterlife.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Default recommends six fields and waits for user confirmation; Quick resolves from request and sources in Agent context.
decision_nodes.output: Confirmed or transient communication contract for outline and page briefs.
decision_nodes.fallback: Blank means no explicit constraint and is not replaced by the original recommendation; Quick derives from source/request.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Source-only; Quick does not persist the transient contract.

decision_nodes.name: Reading density and content divergence
decision_nodes.input: Audience, live/async delivery, afterlife, source structure and preservation constraints.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Derive reading mode from delivery context; interpret user divergence prose on a closeness spectrum; reading mode changes page grammar and density.
decision_nodes.output: Reading mode and source reshaping boundary.
decision_nodes.fallback: Balanced is the default; exact/locked 1:1 requirements preserve source order/content; facts remain sourced.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Source-only.

decision_nodes.name: Narrative mode and visual direction
decision_nodes.input: Confirmed communication contract, source relationships, style constraints and template context.
decision_nodes.candidates: One communication mode, one visual style, and one paired rendering strategy; each can be catalog preset or custom; three complete design directions precede selection.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Strategist creates three project-fit directions before loading selected catalog bases; user confirms Stage 2. No deterministic scorer is specified.
decision_nodes.output: Mode, style, rendering choice, rationale and selected direction in Design Spec/lock.
decision_nodes.fallback: User/template truth stays fixed; where no dimension can vary, state that boundary instead of forcing differences.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Default source-only; no Stage-2 artifact in Quick smoke.

decision_nodes.name: Template family and inherited structure
decision_nodes.input: Explicit workspace roots, indexed candidates, communication contract, declared kind/canvas/prototypes.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Default prepares candidates and asks the user to choose free design or templates; Stage 2 decides use of an installed workspace. Quick validates exact roots directly and skips the planner UI.
decision_nodes.output: Selected template and resulting flat or explicit Master/Layout/slot contract.
decision_nodes.fallback: No root or intent defaults to free design; invalid templates do not silently substitute; no structure is grafted onto an existing deck.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Quick smoke used free design; no template was exercised.

decision_nodes.name: Page budget, pagination, and roster rhythm
decision_nodes.input: Source volume, outline, audience outcome, duration, reading mode and exact/locked count.
decision_nodes.candidates: Narrow Stage-1 page range, exact count, ordered roster, section budgets and rhythm.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Strategist authors the outline and roster; Executor follows IDs/order; compare neighbor rhythm and section arcs.
decision_nodes.output: Page/section budgets, ordered IDs and page_rhythm.
decision_nodes.fallback: Exact/preservation count is binding; changing count/order needs spec repair or reconfirmation; no silent add/drop/merge/split/reorder.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Quick smoke has three pages; hidden planning rationale was not recorded.

decision_nodes.name: Per-page intent and page type
decision_nodes.input: Roster, story arc, content relations and audience move.
decision_nodes.candidates: Page role/type, including cover, divider, closing and content page.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Page brief assigns one purpose and audience move; source structure is a cue, not semantic authority unless explicitly promoted.
decision_nodes.output: SlideIntent and SlideType in Design Spec or transient Quick context.
decision_nodes.fallback: A page advancing nothing is merged, rewritten or cut before roster freeze; later changes respect confirmation boundary.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Quick smoke has page-role markers; rationale was not persisted.

decision_nodes.name: Content granularity, wording, and citations
decision_nodes.input: Source facts, intent, reading mode, divergence, slide area and citation policy.
decision_nodes.candidates: Prose, genuine parallel/ordered lists, structured elements, visible sources, notes, appendix or bounded split.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Choose form from semantic relationship and reading mode, not text length or template slot; preserve facts and qualifiers.
decision_nodes.output: SlideContentSpec and source placement.
decision_nodes.fallback: No silent truncation; restructure/split/move explanation to enabled notes when permitted; otherwise surface conflict.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Smoke text was observed; no citation/overflow case was exercised.

decision_nodes.name: Visual expression and data visualization type
decision_nodes.input: Slide intent, ContentGraph, source data and semantic relationships.
decision_nodes.candidates: Text, image, table, chart, process/timeline/tree/network/matrix/funnel/swimlane diagram, or combined expression.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Select by communication value; map Chart/Table references to pages and validate before lock.
decision_nodes.output: VisualExpressionSpec and optional per-page chart/table reference plus Native-ready map.
decision_nodes.fallback: No chart without supporting data; native eligibility is separate from visual choice; any fallback/loss is explicit.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Smoke had no chart/table/image objects.

decision_nodes.name: Image necessity, source, and asset plan
decision_nodes.input: VisualExpressionSpec, source assets, credentials/instructions, roster and inventory.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Strategist decides image value and assigns allowed source/job; Default acquires after confirmation; Quick prepares resources before drawing.
decision_nodes.output: AssetPlan and image rows with provenance, role, relationship and status.
decision_nodes.fallback: No-AI/editable-only wins; missing required assets block or follow explicit repair/manual/cancel gate; no silent source downgrade.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Smoke deck had zero pictures and no image resources.

decision_nodes.name: Image fit, crop, and multi-image composition
decision_nodes.input: Image dimensions, focal point, slot geometry, image relationship and no-crop constraint.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Choose explicit fit and geometry; preserve focal point and user crop constraints.
decision_nodes.output: ImageFitSpec and image placement/crop geometry in SVG.
decision_nodes.fallback: No-crop blocks crop; if no fit is valid, use an allowed alternative or report conflict.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Not exercised in smoke deck.

decision_nodes.name: Color palette and global visual tokens
decision_nodes.input: User brand/color directives, template inheritance, style, contrast and element roles.
decision_nodes.candidates: User/template-fixed colors or selected preset/custom palette and semantic roles.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Lock user color truth; Strategist records rationale and stable anchors; Executor applies roles to SVG.
decision_nodes.output: Palette and element-level fill/stroke/background/effects.
decision_nodes.fallback: Fixed roles are not changed; unavailable effect is reported or represented by documented alternative; do not infer host defaults.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Palette is visible in smoke output; selection rationale was not persisted.

decision_nodes.name: Typography, text sizing, and fit
decision_nodes.input: Delivery target, font stack/size, CJK/Latin content, reading distance and geometry.
decision_nodes.candidates: Approved concrete families and role anchors; wrapping/reflow or spatial restructure.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Choose target-installed faces, calibrate recurring roles, fit complete copy, and validate text bounds.
decision_nodes.output: TypographySpec and SVG text frames/line breaks.
decision_nodes.fallback: Do not shrink recurring roles or trim wording; restructure/split when allowed or surface fit error.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Quick smoke calibrated text and repaired a warning; final 3/3 pages passed.

decision_nodes.name: Icon concept, library, and prepared pool
decision_nodes.input: Page jobs, confirmed style, icon concepts and allowed libraries.
decision_nodes.candidates: Curated pool from one selected library; optional simple-icons brand IDs.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Strategist chooses relevant icons after page intent; Executor uses prepared assets and applies color/stroke rules.
decision_nodes.output: Icon pool in plan/lock and SVG instances.
decision_nodes.fallback: Re-pick missing icon only in chosen library; do not switch libraries or carry unresolved assets silently.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Smoke deck used no icons.

decision_nodes.name: Per-page topology and relation encoding
decision_nodes.input: Page meaning, content relationship and hierarchy.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Before coordinates, decide what geometry must carry; load topology procedures only when needed.
decision_nodes.output: Topology and connector/containment relationships in SVG.
decision_nodes.fallback: No special relation stays on base path; do not infer topology from repeated shapes/template geometry.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Smoke did not separately assert a complex topology case.

decision_nodes.name: Geometry, native shape contour, and stacking
decision_nodes.input: Page brief, actual content, canvas, style, relation and full shape vocabulary.
decision_nodes.candidates: SVG primitives/native contours and text/image/chart/table carriers; coordinates, grid, alignment and z-order.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Executor owns realization; choose contour before encoding and use the full vocabulary/helper for non-basic geometry.
decision_nodes.output: Page-local geometry and stacking in SVG.
decision_nodes.fallback: Freeform is last tier; unsupported effects use documented alternative or are surfaced; no deterministic geometry scorer is specified.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Editable SVG-derived shapes observed; no geometry scoring trace.

decision_nodes.name: Flat versus structured PPTX structure
decision_nodes.input: Template owner/kind, selected workspace contract and all page SVG metadata.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Free design/Brand/Style stays flat; Layout/Deck owns structured output; structure is explicit and all-page consistent. Quick infers only complete global metadata.
decision_nodes.output: Flat or structured package contract and optional Master/Layout/slot parts.
decision_nodes.fallback: No structure inference/grafting; incomplete structured metadata is rejected/blocked, not silently flattened or repaired.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Smoke used flat output; structured case not exercised.

decision_nodes.name: Native Chart/Table eligibility and visible representation
decision_nodes.input: Chart/Table reference, data, visible SVG fallback, Native-ready declaration and exporter capability.
candidates: native editable object with SVG preview
decision_nodes.mechanism: Reference and Native-ready are independent; checker/fingerprint and exporter validate explicit metadata before materializing.
decision_nodes.output: Visible SVG plus optional native object metadata/parts.
decision_nodes.fallback: Typed slot requiring native object is refused instead of flattened; visual reference alone never establishes capability.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Smoke had no chart/table parts.

decision_nodes.name: Formula and hyperlink realization
decision_nodes.input: Exact source LaTeX/link target, text, and page meaning.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Preserve exact formula/URI; Executor selects supported carrier and follows its authoring contract.
decision_nodes.output: Visible formula preview and/or clickable anchor.
decision_nodes.fallback: Never guess destination or invent decorative formula; report unsupported preservation or request content correction.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Smoke had no formulas or hyperlinks.

decision_nodes.name: Notes, motion, transitions, and narration
decision_nodes.input: Explicit instruction, scenario, SlideIntent and optional animation sidecar.
decision_nodes.candidates: Notes on/off, Custom Animations on/off, narration on/off, transition and object motion.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Default recommends notes true, animation false and narration false unless explicit/confirmed outcome changes them; a motion suggestion alone does not activate a stage.
decision_nodes.output: Notes, motion configuration and optional narrated media.
decision_nodes.fallback: Narration requires notes; unsupported/invalid effects fail rather than silently downgrading; no untriggered effect.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Smoke explicitly disabled notes/animations; no motion render tested.

decision_nodes.name: Quality gate, repair, and fallback reporting
decision_nodes.input: SVG roster/resources/geometry, checker findings, package and Postflight results.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Route owns checker cadence; review full findings, fix errors plus selected warnings in one pass, then recheck; exporter writes Postflight report.
decision_nodes.output: Quality report, pass/fail, carrier receipt and Postflight report.
decision_nodes.fallback: Blocking errors prevent export; warnings are advisory; failure requires repair or explicit unsupported report, never silent downgrade.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: Quick final gate passed 3/3 after a repair; Postflight passed.

decision_nodes.name: Revision and terminal state
decision_nodes.input: Revision request, owning SVG/spec/lock, sidecars, QA findings and export trace.
decision_nodes.mechanism: Default updates source plan/lock or SVG under confirmation gates; Quick edits SVG/related artifacts; both rerun final QA and export.
decision_nodes.output: New validated PPTX version with previous exports retained.
decision_nodes.fallback: Roster/count changes require reconfirmation; unsupported edits are reported; no generic reverse-PPTX edit is implied.
decision_nodes.runtime_evidence: No revision request in smoke run.

limits: Crosswalk is a source study and does not mark any unified DEC node implemented or product-verified.
Where a decision is delegated to Agent/LLM, prompts and output fields are mapped; no deterministic score is claimed unless the source specifies one.
Quick smoke confirms resulting output only; Default remains source-only.
P01-04 template/layout/IR extraction and P01-05 capability mapping are separate tasks.
